instruction: Look at the recommended extensions document and install the middle three plugins from the list into Chrome.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the middle 3 extensions from the 5-item list (positions 2-4: Speechify, React Developer Tools, Momentum). Uses existing evaluator functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: Extracts installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file at extensions.settings[id].manifest.name (chrome.py:1438-1472) - correct data source for installed extensions

Metric logic correct: Uses subset check set_expected_extensions.issubset(set_installed_extensions) (chrome.py:102-117) - correctly verifies all expected extensions are present while allowing extra extensions

Expected values semantically correct: Middle 3 from 5-item list ['Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader', 'React Developer Tools', 'Momentum'] accurately matches instruction requirement for middle three plugins
Data flow correct: Getter returns list of extension names -> Metric performs subset verification -> Returns binary score (1.0 if all expected present, 0.0 otherwise)

Parameter handling correct: Metric signature is (installed_extensions, expected) and correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get the list. No wrong patterns like expected.get('rules') or expected.get('type')

State accessibility excellent: Extension data persists in Chrome Preferences file (~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences), no UI/dialog dependency, can be read reliably even when Chrome is closed

Edge cases handled properly: Empty list returns 0.0 (chrome.py:103-104), subset check allows extra extensions (appropriate since task only requires specific 3 to be installed), missing extensions correctly fail verification
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies exactly what instruction requires - all 3 middle extensions must be installed. Binary pass/fail is appropriate for this installation verification task
Postconfig present: Task includes postconfig to relaunch Chrome (lines 73-92), ensuring browser is in clean state for verification
